info.title: Giggles HTTP API
info.description: The strict JSON profile of giggles.v1.Giggles. HTTPS with verified client certificates is mandatory. Persistent sessions share transactions across HTTP and gRPC calls, including reconnects with the same certificate. One Execute owns a session through response completion. Session handles do not grant authority by themselves. Only documented lowerCamel field names are accepted. No compression, query parameters, automatic retries, DDL capability expansion, approval issuance or identity-selection fields. Close/expiry drops uncommitted state once active ownership permits; a lost response never proves rollback. Domain errors remain successful transport responses. Metadata/protocol errors may terminate a connection instead of yielding an envelope. Native operation, atomic transaction, and explicit begin/commit/rollback arms execute the typed core API directly. Native catalog DDL uses the retained session. Bound handles and once/idempotency APIs are not exposed.

servers.description: Illustrative address; use the operator-configured HTTPS listener.

post.description: The request must not include x-giggles-session. Query strings are rejected. Client certificate verification failure ends the TLS handshake.

201.description: New session. Treat sessionId as sensitive.

400.description: Malformed message, metadata or query string; nothing dispatched.

401.description: Unbound or stale connection identity. Invalidation at release can follow an already committed decision.

404.description: Unknown, closed, expired or other-identity handle.

429.description: Rate, API-call or logical-session capacity exhausted. Nothing dispatched.

post.summary: Run native text, structured operations, SQL or a scoped task operation
post.description: A valid admitted execution refreshes idle time after completion. SQL BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK retain the existing Session across calls. Core errors may abort a transaction; ROLLBACK recovers an aborted live session. Missing default scalar/repeated fields in replies retain their protobuf defaults. Output is bounded to 8388608 bytes. No response implies no certainty about whether a decision committed.

mutualTLS.description: Certificate leaf fingerprint must have a current server binding. Identity cannot be selected in headers or message fields.

sessionHandle.name: x-giggles-session
sessionHandle.description: Sensitive opaque handle additionally bound to the verified certificate and binding epoch. Not a standalone bearer authorization.

SessionHeader.name: x-giggles-session
SessionHeader.description: Exactly one ASCII header. Duplicate, missing, comma-joined or malformed values are rejected. Keep out of logs.

UInt64.description: Canonical unsigned decimal string, 0 through 18446744073709551615 inclusive. Numeric JSON tokens, leading zeros, signs, whitespace, fractions and exponents are rejected.

Int64.description: Canonical signed decimal string, -9223372036854775808 through 9223372036854775807 inclusive. No leading plus, leading zeros or negative zero.

Bytes.description: Canonical standard padded base64, including empty bytes. URL-safe variants, omitted required padding, whitespace and nonzero unused bits are rejected.

SessionId.description: Opaque secret bound to the exact authenticated leaf certificate and its current binding epoch. Never place it in logs, URLs or cookies.

textValue.description: UTF-8 text, including empty strings and escaped NUL/control characters.

Value.description: Exactly one typed value. JSON null and missing values are rejected.

items.description: Order and duplicates are preserved. Existing core rules reject duplicate keys.

Selection.description: Predicate bounds retain the existing half-open [from, until) interpretation.

sql.description: SQL passed unchanged to Service. Existing core limits apply: 65536 UTF-8 bytes and 256 parameters; core failures are ExecuteReply domain results.

code.description: Existing Service decision code, including success and domain errors. A domain error retains HTTP 200; never infer retry safety from it. Post-dispatch output encoding or size failure yields the fixed domain code 08007 and retains transaction state; this is an ambiguous outcome, not proof of rollback. Native success uses ok; fixed native domain error classes use native_error (Unknown remains 08007). Existing authority/aborted/cancellation classes retain their fixed SQLSTATE codes.

budgetMs.description: Decision budget in milliseconds. Zero never starts a decision. Must be a JSON integer token; 1.0 and 1e0 are rejected even if a JSON Schema validator treats them as integers.

ExecuteRequest.description: Exactly one request alternative. Duplicate keys, aliases, unknown fields, JSON null, trailing documents and nesting deeper than 128 are rejected by the parser. Raw UTF-8 body limit is 262144 bytes including whitespace. Native request trees are typed directly into the core operation engine; SQL is a separate optional arm. Semantic core failures use nativeError in a successful HTTP 200 reply.

enum: internal error; outcome may be ambiguous

bindings.description: At most 256 unique case-sensitive names. Duplicate names rejected before map conversion. Combined value payload at most 65536 bytes: UTF-8 text/bytes length; nine bytes per scalar. Logical presence of names and values required.

page.description: Keyset paging (core read_page) for a read request. Absent: the request runs unpaged. An empty or omitted after starts at the first page; otherwise after is the previous reply's nextPage.after. The read's limit is the page size.

NativePage.description: Keyset continuation: the order-key values of the last row returned.

NativeCatalogRequest.description: Exactly one synchronous catalog request. Unknown fields, duplicate keys and JSON null are rejected at every request level. Arrays omitted from requests default to empty; core validates their semantics. Names are exact identifiers resolved using the retained search_path. Errors use the existing native error mapping.

NativeForeignKey.description: refColumnsSet absent or false means inferred referenced primary key, ignoring refColumns; true preserves refColumns including empty. Actions use exact enum names.

NativeCreateView.description: CREATE VIEW name AS the typed read (single source or join). Authorization: CREATE on (or ownership of) the creation schema and SELECT on every read relation, like SQL CREATE VIEW. Reply: catalogOutcome with the canonical schema.view.

NativeDropView.description: DROP VIEW [CASCADE]. Authorization: ownership of the view, like SQL DROP VIEW.

NativeCreateSequence.description: CREATE SEQUENCE with default options. Authorization as SQL: superuser or CREATE on schema public. Reply: catalogOutcome with the canonical schema.sequence and empty columns and primaryKey.

NativeDropSequence.description: DROP SEQUENCE [CASCADE]; ownership required, as SQL.

NativeSequenceCall.description: One sequence function call in the retained session. The reply's sql result equals SQL SELECT nextval/currval/setval(...): one row, one bigint column named after the function.

NativeCatalogOutcome.description: Logical catalog metadata; hidden row IDs are excluded. table is canonical schema-qualified (new name after rename). Drops return removed table or owning-table metadata. indexId is present for index creation/deletion.

items.description: At most 63 UTF-8 bytes; no NUL.

NativeSearchPathRequest.description: Read unless set is true. Nonempty schemas require set=true; true with omitted schemas clears the path.

NativeTypedRead.description: Exact source identifiers, authorized for SELECT before binding. Uses the retained SQL session and returns operationOutcome rows, matched=row count, affected=changed=0, complete=true. At most 4096 expression nodes, depth 24 (root=0). Scalar positions accept column/literal/aggregate; predicate positions accept compare/isNull/notExpr/andExpr/orExpr. Single-source groupBy accepts unqualified columns only; joins accept typed scalar group expressions. Binding/execution errors use nativeError kind SQL with the underlying SQLSTATE, and abort an open transaction.

text.description: Native data statement or atomic block; at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes. Catalog, inspection, explain and once/receipt text are refused.

NativeTextRequest.description: Pure lowering followed by the same table authorization, execution and results as operation/transaction. Uses the retained session; begin/commit/rollback controls accept text operations inside them. Unknown version, parse/lowering or wire-binding failure: HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT before leasing. Engine errors follow the structured request result path.

bindings.description: At most 256 unique case-sensitive names. Duplicate names rejected before map conversion. Combined value payload at most 65536 bytes: UTF-8 text/bytes length; nine bytes per scalar. Logical presence of names and values required.

NativeRequest.description: Exactly one of the ten typed core operations. Wrapper nesting is limited to Returning -> OnConflict -> direct insertion, or one eligible wrapper. Native execution never generates SQL. Core serialized input and resolved value limits remain 65536 bytes each.

NativeInsertMany.description: At most 1024 explicit rows; every row width must equal columns length (at most 64). cap is logically required. Core binding and mutation bounds apply.

NativeExpr.description: Recursive typed expression, maximum 24 child edges from root (root depth 0), intentionally stricter than embedded core depth 32. Maximum 4096 expression nodes across the whole operation or atomic block, including guards, returning, conflict updates, requirements and scalar emits. CASE operand/WHEN/THEN/ELSE each adds one expression edge. No implicit simplification.

NativeTransaction.description: Atomic typed block within the retained session. readOnly is logically required, including false. At most 64 steps plus a present emit; at most 64 local names. Claim cannot appear in a block. Steps may refer only to earlier locals. A present empty emit remains distinct from an absent emit and is rejected by the core. Requirements produce no step summary. A block stages into an existing explicit transaction; otherwise it owns and commits one transaction.

nextPage.description: Paging mode only: send it back as page to read the next page. Absent on the last page (complete is then true).

NativeOutcome.description: Counts refer to native matched, affected and changed semantics. Row versions are decimal uint64 strings. conflictResults absence differs from a present empty items list; returnedRow points into this outcome's rows.

NativeStepSummary.description: itemIndex counts original block steps; requirements have no summary. Conflict returnedRow indices remain relative to the operation's return rows.

NativeEmittedRows.description: Typed emitted relation. Empty rows retain their columns and completeness metadata.

sqlstate.description: Underlying SQLSTATE, including SQL (tag 20), DUPLICATE, OVERFLOW and DIVISION_BY_ZERO errors.

NativeError.description: Fixed redacted domain class; never exposes Bind/Core strings. Syntax supplies a decimal-string offset. Unknown (ambiguous commit) uses top-level code 08007. These classes do not authorize automatic retry.
